Name: Nyapu Style Mariner to Mermaid
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Mariner to Seasonal Mermaids [/b][/size][b][size=5]- Nyapu Style by AhCuteArt
[/size][/b][/center]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]I adore Nyapu's style portraits and custom NPCs. My passion project at the moment is to create Nyapu-style portraits for all the NPCs in my mega-modded SDV file. 

Merry Christmas, everyone! Okay, this is it. After a bit of a holiday retexturing (and CP coding) marathon, I am going to take a break. I've been wanting to do this one for a while, since I love seasonal mods. And mermaids? What's not to like? I tried to test the code to the best of my ability. Let me know if you have any issues (and pray I can figure out how to fix it.)

[b]INSTALLATION (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22799]Seasonal Mariner to Mermaid[/url]﻿
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23881]Old Mariner Gives the Mermaid Her Pendant Back[/url]﻿
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35358]They Deserve It Too - Portraits for Extras[/url]﻿
2. ﻿Unzip and drag the replacement into your mods folder

[b]There are Two files:[/b]
[Main File] CP is just a drag and drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. 
You should get a prompt to replace the original files if you do it right.
If you need more guidance, Nyapu has a great example on their page. 

[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3526422]JennaJuffuffles[/url] for allowing me to retexture their mod.
A Huge thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for creating such amazing mods (and teaching me how to code)
